messages:
maria: quick sync  I'm exploring a micro-attrib model: emit a tiny immutable 'envelope' at ingress with keys only, move heavy attribution to async stitcher. idea is to cut tail latency for realtime calls. reactions?
ajay: sounds useful for p99. main worry: coupling. once ingest stamps an attrib we become more brittle for schema changes/backfills.
sam: +1 on brittleness. also need a reproducible audit path. if stitcher derives differently we get disputes.
maria: proposal detail: envelope fields = {tenant, req_id, model_hint, fp, schema_id, flags, proof20}. very small (sub-200 bytes). stitcher consumes envelope + raw event (if needed) and emits billing rows.
priya: fp idea: deterministic across SDKs. My suggestion: canonicalize input, compute prefix_hash = sha256(canonical_input) then fingerprint = base64url(sha256(prefix_hash + tenant))[0:20]. include schema_id so we can change alg later.

ajay: canonicalization rules are critical. JSON ordering, whitespace, truncated contexts. Where do we keep canonicalization spec? it'll be a contract used by SDKs + ingest lib.
tess: ops question: where do envelopes live? topic per-region? global compaction? we need fast lookup for audits.
sam: think about compact ledger: write envelope to a compacted topic keyed by fp. That gives O(1) lookup for audits and avoids long-term raw retention. but compaction + late-arrivals = complexity.
maria: exactly. plan: compaction window = 72h. keep raw events in cold store for 14d. within 72h we expect most late events. after window, late arrivals go to a backfill path that writes audit-deltas only.
priya: tombstone policy: when we tombstone a fingerprint after reconcile, we must keep tombstone for extra 7d to allow consumers to detect deletions. document this in playbook.
ajay: cross-region: fingerprint algorithm must be bit-identical across language runtimes. include a version byte in envelope (schema_id) and a text description in proto. failing unknown schema -> mark as "legacy" and route to slow path.
ci-bot: ci:metering-schema tests passed on main (commit a3d9). :white_check_mark:
tess: rollout strategy: start with 1% traffic ingest-producing envelopes, double daily. run stitcher in parallel and measure mismatch_rate between ingest-pre-annotations and stitcher final decisions. threshold=0.05% mismatch to continue.
sam: need a replay diff tool that can replay envelopes and stitcher outputs for a tenant/time-range. I'll sketch that tool; it should support field-level diffs and root-cause hints.
maria: metrics to add: envelope_emit_rate, envelope_size_p50/95, stitch_mismatch_count, stitch_mismatch_rate_per_tenant. also an alert if mismatch > 0.1% over 1h.
priya: backfill plan: keep raw in cold store 14d. when backfilling, rehydrate raw events -> regen envelopes (if missing) -> stitch -> produce audit events. log a repair record keyed by fp.
ajay: cost ask: I'll estimate delta (GB/day) for envelopes at 100M qps baseline and cost of compacted retention vs raw S3.
maria: ok action items: Priya -> canonicalization + fingerprint RFC by Tue. Ajay -> storage/network cost estimate. Sam -> replay diff tool spec + compaction window draft. Tess -> rollout canary plan doc. I'll open prototype branch to start emitting envelopes into a test topic.
tess: +1. scheduling a 30m sync tomorrow to unblock infra permissions.
sam: +1. will include sample flag handling for eval routing in my spec.
